items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: I collaborated with him in playing and arranging and writing some music

ctx.x: And his brother, Russell Jacquet on trumpet. But this didn't last too long because we didn't have any bookings and so forth, and I went back to New York and continued on with my association and then we got together again in New York when he later came there, and I collaborated with him in playing and arranging and writing some music, out of which came my composition 'Robin's Nest'. That was in 1947.
